summary: Iteration 12 — Stripe booking payment (backend + frontend, mobile viewport 375x667). Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass on /api/bookings/{id}/pay, /api/payments/status/{sid}, guards, idempotency & seed booking bkg_7c6591810676 branch. Frontend (Expo web preview, CLIENT token demo-preview-token-123): fresh confirmed UNPAID booking (bkg_d9509994164d, total €33.35) renders pay-button labelled 'Paga ora · €33.35' with 'Pagamenti sicuri con Stripe' note; complete-button and paid-banner are correctly HIDDEN. Tapping pay-button initiated a REAL Stripe checkout session and browser navigated to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_a15o18pGvDwzfYTcB5BKMvf4CA9vAmRALrCXZhY4rGUz3I5HQeBTHgEI0T… (no card entered, per spec). After flipping the booking's payment_status='paid' in MongoDB, the same screen now shows paid-banner ('Pagamento completato · €33.35') and the complete-button ('Segna come completata'); pay-button is removed. All acceptance criteria in the review_request are met.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props deprecated (use 'boxShadow'). Multiple emissions on every page render. Cosmetic (RN Web only), tracked previously. Reference: theme/shadow objects across UI components.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated (use style.pointerEvents). Cosmetic. Reference: components using pointerEvents prop.

critical_code_review_comments: payments_stripe._settle_if_paid correctly idempotents via 'credited' bool before crediting wallet or flipping booking.payment_status. Setting 'credited=True' happens BEFORE the branch work but that's still safe because the update is atomic per-session_id.
pay_booking uses server-side amount from db.bookings.total (labor + 15% JOBBY fee written at select_provider). Confirmed via test_pay_amount_uses_db_total.
Guards implemented cleanly: 404 unknown booking, 403 non-owner, and short-circuit {'already_paid': True} when payment_status=='paid'.
Frontend booking/[id].tsx correctly gates the complete-button behind payment_status==='paid' for clients, keeps the in-progress complete-button unconditional (providers/handoff flow after start).

On web the pay flow uses window.location.href = url (full-page redirect) — good, avoids popup blockers. On native it uses expo-web-browser + pollPayment(sid) — polls /payments/status up to 6× at 1.5s intervals, which will settle the booking as soon as Stripe reports paid.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (unpaid + paid UI states + Stripe redirect all verified)

seed_data_creation: Created mission msn_458860a8ae97 and booking bkg_d9509994164d (client user_demopreview01, provider bot Anna Greco, category pulizie, total €33.35). Booking left in payment_status='paid' after DB flip during the PAID-scenario UI test. Two Stripe test-mode checkout sessions were created against it (test_pay_amount_uses_db_total + the UI redirect).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Storage layer (src/utils/storage) JSON.parses values, so to inject the bearer token in localStorage use JSON.stringify: window.localStorage.setItem('jobby_session_token', JSON.stringify('demo-preview-token-123')). Otherwise you'll see repeated '[storage] retrieve(parse error)' warnings and 401s. Client-owned demo booking bkg_d9509994164d is now paid; use it for regression of the paid UI state, or run the mission→select flow again to get a fresh confirmed/unpaid booking. Real Stripe test-mode checkout URLs are returned (host checkout.stripe.com, session_id starts with cs_test_). Do NOT actually complete a card payment through automation — Stripe payment settlement is exercised only through the webhook / GET /payments/status endpoints in backend tests.
